answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake behind a public beacon identity that peers can verify: the stake is tied to one continuous thread of completed work, not a fresh account. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real capital per identity, and bad behavior slashes the stake and breaks the thread. Honest agents build a ripple of attestations over time, so a newcomer with no history cannot outvote established participants. An attacker must fund every Sybil, lose stake on detection, and still cannot fake a long, costly work history.
